categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Tagged with maintainers' Consensus label and modifies signature cache hashing in src/script/sigcache.{cpp,h}, which directly guards script verification in validation.
categories.rationale: Hardens signature-cache key hashing against potential collisions by introducing explicit length framing. As acknowledged in the description, 'Bitcoin Core's signature-cache encoding is unambiguous for inputs accepted by its current script checker', meaning there is no active vulnerability, but retiring this fragile hashing pattern defensively addresses an issue that caused exploits in related software.
